text.p: KINGSTON, Jamaica, Oct 25, Reuter - Jamaica's bauxite and alumina production rose for the first three quarters of 1996, although the industry's earnings slipped in the first six months of the year, according to figures released Friday by the Jamaica Bauxite Institute.

Total bauxite production as of September reached 8.9 million metric tons, up 9 pct over last year's figure. Total shipments climbed 11 percent over the same period, from 8.1 million metric tons to 9 million tonnes.
Figures for alumina exports and gross earnings for the bauxite and alumina sector were available only through June.
Alumina exports as of June rose 6.66 pct over last year, from 1.44 million metric tons to 1.54 million tons.
Gross earnings figures as of June showed the sector earned US$338 million, down 4.4 pct from last year's US$353.4 million.
